transport: Plugs into the charger's own display header. Not a network endpoint and not addressable from a gateway. Its settings are reachable only indirectly, as VE.Direct HEX registers on the host charger.
blocks: Exposed on the host charger, not on the display: 0x0400 backlight mode (0 keypress / 1 on / 2 auto) · 0x0401 backlight intensity · 0x0402 scroll text speed (1 slow .. 5 fast) · 0x0403 setup lock · 0x0404 temperature unit (0 Celsius / 1 Fahrenheit, firmware v1.30+).
